report:
Fresh final followup review of unmatched_end. Saved/read previous report and captures before start, recaptured all three dependencies, and compared every fragment. Claim, all three associated tests, source/BookFixture helpers and supplementary heading test are unchanged. The only implementation delta is an implementation_references association comment on another spec.rs method, with no parser behavior change.

The complete claim requires no-active-anchor explicit ends to be errors, including repeated ends after explicit or implicit closure without a new definition, and permits implicit closure at another definition/heading/source boundary without any explicit end. The sole ordinary implementation emits a file/span diagnostic when a recognized standalone end occurs with active None, then finish_anchor takes any active anchor. Headings also consume active state; valid new definitions close the previous rule and establish a new one; source completion needs no explicit end. Each source or Sage prose-block parse starts independent state, and dedented Sage error spans map back to original bytes. The added comment affects none of these paths.

All ordinary test evidence remains meaningful. unmatched_ends_are_errors_after_explicit_implicit_and_source_boundaries covers standalone and consecutive explicit markers and ends after hash/underline headings, asserting exactly one inactive-anchor diagnostic and its exact source slice; its separate-file case checks the second filename and preserved first rule. an_end_marker_in_another_sage_prose_block_is_unmatched checks independent Sage blocks through real workspace loading, exact first content, one error, correct file/message and exact original marker slice. claims_retain_all_blocks_until_the_next_definition_or_document_end omits end markers and requires clean diagnostics, exact contents/source slices and disjoint extents across definition and source-end closure. The separately captured semantic heading test exercises all six ATX levels and both Setext forms with omitted ends, requiring clean diagnostics and exact before/after contents/boundary. It is supporting dependency evidence, not represented as an initially associated unmatched_end test. source and BookFixture helpers pass real text/files to production parsing/loading.

No TODO/N/A entries or deferred requirements exist. The full prior assessment remains justified after checking the actual marker-only delta and unchanged substantive evidence. This review used fresh start/read/record and source inspection, with no source edits or behavioral test execution. No requested edits.
